# Read Mutation Scores From File

This feature enables the system to read precomputed mutation testing scores from a JSON file generated by an external CI mutation testing tool. It parses the file and returns the number of killed, survived, and timeout mutants for each module, so the scores can inform coverage reporting and component normalization.
